title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Azure Cloud Architect** to lead the design and delivery of enterprise\-scale cloud platforms and next\-generation AI solutions. In this role, you will drive cloud transformation initiatives, architect innovative Azure\-based solutions, and provide technical leadership across complex modernization programs. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders, presales teams, and engineering groups to shape scalable, secure, and future\-ready architectures.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect enterprise\-scale Azure cloud platforms and landing zones covering subscriptions, management groups, networking, identity, security, governance, monitoring, and automation
* Design scalable, secure, and highly available solutions using Azure services such as AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, API Management, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage, and related PaaS services
* Define cloud\-native and application modernization strategies including re\-platforming, re\-architecting, containerization, microservices, and event\-driven architectures
* Provide architecture guidance for migration and modernization of large\-scale enterprise workloads to Azure
* Design and integrate Azure OpenAI and GenAI solutions including enterprise AI assistants, RAG\-based solutions, intelligent search, copilots, and AI\-enabled business applications
* Define patterns for integrating Azure OpenAI with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and knowledge repositories
* Ensure appropriate architecture around AI security, identity, data privacy, responsible AI, observability, and governance
* Lead architecture workshops and technical discussions with customers, application teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and senior stakeholders
* Develop reference architectures, architecture blueprints, design standards, and reusable cloud patterns
* Participate in RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, technical estimations, architecture presentations, and customer pitches
* Support presales teams in defining solution scope, architecture, delivery approach, effort estimates, assumptions, and technical risks
* Conduct architecture reviews, provide technical governance across cloud transformation programs, and mentor architects and engineering teams across multiple projects or workstreams

**Requirements**

* 16\-22 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in cloud and enterprise architecture roles
* Strong hands\-on architectural expertise in Microsoft Azure
* Deep understanding of Azure platform and systems architecture, including Azure Landing Zones, Management Groups, and Subscriptions
* Proficiency in Hub\-Spoke/Virtual WAN architectures, networking, and private connectivity
* Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and Azure Policy, along with RBAC, governance, security, monitoring, and observability
* Skills in Azure PaaS and cloud\-native technologies including AKS/Kubernetes, containers, and App Service
* Familiarity with Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Grid
* Competency in Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage, and related managed services
* Background in microservices, APIs, and distributed systems, along with integration patterns and event\-driven architectures
* Experience designing application modernization and cloud migration strategies for large enterprise environments
* Expertise in Azure OpenAI Service and GenAI architecture, including integration of LLM\-based capabilities into enterprise applications
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, and vector search, as well as prompt orchestration, AI agents, and enterprise GenAI architecture patterns
* Consulting and customer\-facing experience with the ability to engage senior technical and business stakeholders, participate in RFPs, RFIs, presales solutioning, estimations, and technical proposal development
* Capability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical cloud architecture

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and Azure Machine Learning
* Background in FinOps and cloud cost optimization
* Exposure to large\-scale cloud migration or modernization programs
* Microsoft Azure Architect or other relevant cloud certifications
* Experience working with global enterprise customers or distributed engineering teams

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development

	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits

title: Azure Network Specialist
description:
ViaPlus is seeking a Senior Network SRE to own and drive the end\-to\-end architecture, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise\-scale network platforms across Microsoft Azure cloud and on\-premises data center environments. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that ViaPlus’ high\-volume, real\-time transaction systems remain highly available, resilient, and secure.
 



  





 This position will work closely with Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, Application, and Data teams to align network architecture with application performance, security requirements, and business objectives. The Senior Network SRE will also be responsible for driving automation, observability, and governance standards, contributing to capacity planning, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous reliability improvements.
 



  





**About Viaplus**

 :
 




 ViaPlus is a global mobility company in the Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) market, specializing in revenue and services management solutions for the transportation industry. Our customer operations, data analytics, and full\-featured single\-account back\-office technology facilitate the high\-volume transactions, required for seamless multimodal mobility. As a VINCI Concessions subsidiary, we are committed to technical innovation and to promoting a positive mobility experience for all. We are pioneers in the transportation transaction and mobility industry, with a decade of proven global experience in providing solutions focused on the tolling and transit industries.
 



  





 ViaPlus is headquartered near Dallas, Texas and maintains offices across the United States and in France, India, and Ireland. We are part of the global network of VINCI Concessions, an international player in transport infrastructure with projects in 23 countries. Our vision has evolved to provide a fully automated, end\-to\-end transportation solution that significantly improves revenue collection and efficiency while effectively lowering costs for our agency clients.
 



  





 We serve enterprises that require high\-volume, real\-time transactions processing with the highest levels of accuracy, especially where revenue reconciliation and customer account management are key deliverables to the customer experience. Our flagship back\-office system (BOS) enables Mobility\-as\-a\-Service (MaaS) with a “one account” feature that supports multimodal transportation solutions. In a rapidly\-changing environment, ViaPlus maintains a strong focus on technology and continuous R\&D to improve agency efficiencies, reduce operating expenses, and maximize revenue – all while providing exceptional customer service.
 



  





**About Indian Operations:**




 Plan, Design and Develop New Features for our Products \| Customize our product on request from our premium Clients \| Provide end\-to\-end IT Infrastructure set\-up and Maintenance for global Clients \| 24/7 Support and provide services to our ASP Clients
 



  





**Job Profile: Senior Network SRE**




**Experience: 6 \-10yrs**









**Job Responsibilities:**



* Design and implement scalable Azure network architectures (Hub\-Spoke, Landing Zones, vWAN).
* Build and manage hybrid connectivity solutions: ExpressRoute, VPN, VNet Peering, Private Link.
* Define North–South/East–West traffic flows, segmentation, and micro\-segmentation strategies.
* Create and maintain HLD/LLD designs, network diagrams, and architecture standards.
* Configure and optimize Azure Application Gateway, Azure Load Balancer (L4/L7\), and traffic routing.
* Implement SSL termination, path\-based routing, session affinity, and health probes.
* Deploy and tune Azure WAF (OWASP rules, custom rules, bot protection).
* Architect global solutions using Azure Front Door (CDN, edge security, global load balancing, multi\-region failover).
* Implement Zero Trust–aligned network security controls across cloud and on\-prem.
* Manage NSGs, ASGs, Azure Firewall, DDoS Protection, and threat detection workflows.
* Integrate network telemetry with SIEM/SOC tools (Azure Sentinel preferred).
* Lead capacity planning, performance tuning, and traffic engineering.
* Define and maintain SOPs, runbooks, best practices, and network governance.
* Troubleshoot advanced latency, routing, packet loss, and connectivity issues.
* Support DR/BCP planning and ensure network resiliency.
* Implement IaC using Terraform, Bicep, and ARM templates.
* Collaborate with DevOps to integrate network deployments into CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate network provisioning for repeatable and consistent builds.
* Work closely with Cloud, Security, DevOps, Application, and Data teams.
* Present architecture decisions to leadership (CIO/CTO) and guide technology choices.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across projects.



  





**Skill Set:**



* Deep knowledge of Azure Virtual Network, App Gateway, front door, Load Balancer, AFD, Azure Firewall.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP, VPN, SD\-WAN.
* Experience with enterprise firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, CheckPoint, Cisco ASA).
* Hands\-on with monitoring tools: Azure Monitor, Network Watcher, Traffic Analytics.
* Strong troubleshooting skills (Wireshark, packet captures, routing diagnostics).
* Tools \& Automation
* Terraform / Bicep / ARM
* Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD
* PowerShell, Python (optional but preferred)



  





**Qualifications:**




 Any Graduate with B. E / B. Tech, MCA or equivalent degree with more than 6\+ years relevant work experience.
 



 4 years of experience in Network Engineering/Architecture.
 



 Minimum 4 years of Azure cloud networking experience.
 



  





**Certifications Preferred:**



* AZ\-700: Azure Network Engineer Associate
* AZ\-305: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* CCNP / CCIE (for on\-prem routing/switching)
* Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSE



  





**We invite you to explore this opportunity to be a part of the ViaPlus family……**

Job Description: Cloud Security Engineer
 



**Reports to:** 
 Security Lead
 



**Level:** 
 Mid (IC)
 



 Mission
 



 Own the identity, access, and network security control plane — CyberArk, Zscaler and Cloudflare — for a fast\-scaling, AI\-driven insurance infrastructure org. You'll take these tools from initial deployment handoff to steady, auditable, day\-2 operations, and be the technical backbone the Security Lead relies on for privileged access and network security posture.
 



 What you'll own
 



 • CyberArk (PAM) — safe/policy design, privileged account lifecycle, credential rotation monitoring, access recertification

 • Take over day\-2 administration of CyberArk from the implementation partner; ensure clean runbooks/SOPs exist and are maintained

 • Partner with engineering teams as headcount scales to keep IAM and network controls usable, not just secure
 



 • Support technical deep\-dives requested by auditors or pen testers on identity/network architecture
 



 • Identify opportunities to automate policy\-drift detection and routine PAM/SSE administration, in line with the team's AI\-driven, lean operating model
 



 • Escalate control\-design questions or audit findings on these tools to the Security Lead
 



 What we're looking for
 



 • 3–6\+ years in security engineering, with hands\-on ownership of at least one PAM platform (CyberArk strongly preferred) in production
 



 • Working experience with a cloud SSE/ZTNA platform (Zscaler, Cloudflare Access, or similar) and a CDN/WAF
 



 • Comfortable being the sole owner of high\-scrutiny controls in an audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)
 



 • Strong scripting/automation ability (Python, Terraform, or similar) to keep a lean team's operational load sustainable
 



 • Clear written communication — you'll produce evidence and explanations auditors and pen testers can follow
 



 Nice to have
 



 • Insurance, financial services, or other regulated\-industry background
 



 • Experience standing up or maturing a PAM program from a fresh implementation
 



 • Exposure to NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law or similar state insurance regulatory frameworks
 



 How we'll know you're succeeding
 



 • CyberArk, Zscaler, and Cloudflare pass audit control tests with minimal findings
 



 • Privileged access recertification completed on schedule every cycle
 



 • No unplanned production impact from policy changes across owned tools
 



 • Routine administration increasingly automated rather than manual quarter over quarter

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 Mobileum is a leading provider of Telecom analytics solutions for roaming, core network, security, risk management, domestic and international connectivity testing, and customer intelligence. More than 1,000 customers rely on its Active Intelligence platform, which provides advanced analytics solutions, allowing customers to connect deep network and operational intelligence with real\-time actions that increase revenue, improve customer experience, and reduce costs. Know our story: https://www.mobileum.com/
 



  





 Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Mobileum has global offices in Australia, Dubai, Germany, Greece, India, Portugal, Singapore and UK with global HC of over 1800\+.
 



  





**About NTR:** 




  





 NTR (Network Traffic Redirector) is Mobileum's flagship in\-path roaming traffic steering solution, deployed across 600\+ operator networks worldwide and engineered for five\-nines availability. Built on Core Java, RAID (our no\-code/low\-code UI and ETL platform), Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and Kubernetes/OpenShift, NTR steers roaming traffic in real time at carrier scale. We're now building agentic, GenAI\-powered copilot capabilities on top of NTR, enabling autonomous configuration, natural\-language operator assistance, and intelligent, self\-healing traffic\-steering decisions.
 



  





**Overview:** 









 We are hiring a Principal Engineer to architect Mobileum's agentic, GenAI\-powered copilot capabilities for NTR — our carrier\-grade, in\-path roaming traffic steering platform used across 600\+ operator networks. You will design how multi\-agent orchestration, tool integration, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) let NTR autonomously configure and operate itself, while staying hands\-on with core NTR engineering and mentoring the wider team. This is a deep technical architecture role: you set the target\-state design and technical standards for agentic AI on NTR, and you're still writing code and prototyping alongside the team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Agentic Architecture \& Strategy** 



* Define the target\-state architecture for NTR's agentic copilot platform: multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function\-calling integration, and RAG pipelines over NTR configuration, telemetry, and documentation
* Select and evaluate agent frameworks, LLM providers, and orchestration patterns (e.g., LangGraph\-style stateful workflows)
* Define the model\-hosting strategy (self\-hosted/on\-prem vs. API\-based LLMs), accounting for the data\-residency and security constraints typical of Tier\-1 telco on\-premise deployments
* Establish safety, guardrail, and evaluation standards for autonomous or semi\-autonomous NTR actions (approval workflows, audit trails, hallucination/regression checks)



  





**Platform \& Integration Engineering** 



* Architect the integration layer between agentic services and NTR's Core Java backend (with a RAID\-based no\-code/low\-code UI), ensuring safe, auditable access to live configuration and telemetry
* Design context management, memory, and retrieval strategy across NTR's data stores (Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL)
* Set standards for agent observability, tracing, and production monitoring



**Core NTR Engineering** 



* Remain hands\-on with core NTR features and architecture: roaming traffic steering, signaling/session handling, and high\-availability service design
* Ensure the copilot platform meets NTR's carrier\-grade, five\-nines reliability bar



  





**Technical Leadership \& Enablement** 



* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to the Technical Lead and engineers building on the platform
* Partner with product, telecom domain experts, and customers to prioritize agentic use cases with the highest operator impact
* Represent the agentic AI roadmap in architecture reviews and executive updates



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




  





**Core Engineering** 



* Deep expertise in Core Java, distributed systems, and backend architecture at carrier scale; familiarity with RAID (Mobileum's no\-code/low\-code UI and ETL platform) a plus
* Strong system design across distributed data stores (Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar), Kafka, and Kubernetes/OpenShift



  





**Agentic AI \& GenAI** 



* Proven experience architecting production LLM/agentic systems: multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, RAG
* Deep familiarity with agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and Python
* Strong grasp of vector databases, context/memory management, and agent evaluation, safety, and observability practices



  





**Telecom Domain** 



* Familiarity with telecom/roaming systems, protocols, and roaming analytics; NTR or similar in\-path traffic\-steering experience a strong plus



  





**Leadership** 



* Strong technical influence and mentorship without relying on direct management authority



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 12–16 years of software engineering experience with deep distributed systems/backend architecture expertise (Core Java)
* 3\+ years hands\-on designing and shipping production LLM\-based or agentic AI systems
* Proven ability to set technical direction and influence across teams without direct authority



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Telecom/roaming domain experience, ideally including NTR or in\-path traffic\-steering products
* Deep experience with agent orchestration frameworks and multi\-agent architecture patterns
* Familiarity with MCP/A2A or similar agent communication protocols
* Experience with model evaluation, safety/guardrails, and production LLM observability
* Exposure to fine\-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) or model serving infrastructure



  





**Work Experience: 12\-16 Years** 




  





**Educational Qualification:** 
 BE. / B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech. or M. Sc. in Computer Science / Electronics Engineering / MCA

description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 


 About the role
 
 Roku pioneered TV streaming and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The Roku Channel has us well\-positioned to help shape the future of streaming. Continued success relies on investing in the Roku Cloud TV Platform so we deliver high quality streaming TV experience at a global scale.
 



 You will be part of the Roku Video Platform Engineering team that is building the next generation video services for the Roku Cloud TV Platform. In this role you will work on key video services projects around video ingestion, encoding, VoD/live\-linear, Ads Insertion services, DRM and Video QoS, with the goal of delivering best\-in\-class streaming TV experience across all of Roku devices. The projects that you will work on will impact millions of Roku users around the world. All along, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with key product engineering stakeholders across Roku engineering teams, and lead the design of our video services platform.
 



 The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical leadership, bring endless curiosity and can pair a global mindset with locally relevant execution. You should be a gritty problem solver and self\-starter who can drive programs with the product and commercial teams within Roku and across external strategic partner organizations. The successful candidate will display a balance of hard and soft skills, including the ability to respond quickly to changing business needs.
   

  




 How will I use AI at Roku?
 
 At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
 



 We value
 
 your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.
 



  
 


 What you’ll be doing
 * You will lead a team of engineers towards building high availability cloud hosted video platform that powers key elements of the Roku streaming platform.
* Spearhead efforts towards building scalable and robust video processing pipelines, improve video workflows including transcoding, packaging, publishing and ads insertion
* Provide technical and organizational leadership in executing our video services initiatives including to deliver high quality, low latency, delightful streaming experiences, fine tune quality of experience, investigate and remediate potential streaming quality of service problems

 We’re excited if you have

* Experience with Ad insertion technologies and frameworks is a big plus!
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders, teams, and senior leaders across the organization. Ability to operate at both hands\-on technical depth and strategic leadership level
* Strong leadership, collaboration and communication skills in working with cross\-functional teams across the organization, and delivering on big and ambitious goals
* Experience in Connected TV environments – with understanding of the unique technical constraints and requirements of this space is a big plus.
* Demonstrable GenAI fluency and in actively using Agentic AI engineering tools to accelerate product development
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, plus 10\+ years of experience or equivalent; Master's degree preferred.



  
 


  
 **What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 



  
 


**What are some of the benefits?** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**What should I know about Roku's culture?** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

===============================

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. description:

This is a high\-impact leadership role for a Transition Managerwho is ready to shape the future of application transitions — combining deep delivery expertise with AI\-powered innovation to redefine how complex global IT services are handed over, stabilized, and scaled.


We are looking for a seasoned **Application Transition Manager** to lead end\-to\-end planning, solutioning, and execution of complex, multi\-service managed services, application development, and support/maintenance transitions. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership, AI\-powered modernization, and enterprise\-scale program governance.


The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom\-built, packaged, and cloud\-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.


You will operate as the single accountable owner across pre\-sales solutioning and live execution, partnering closely with the client, delivery towers, and incumbent vendors to deliver a seamless transition to steady\-state operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Independently design and own transition solutions for complex outsourcing pursuits across multi\-vendor, multi\-geo, multi\-stack, multi\-service (Apps, Infra, Security, Automation, Cloud) environments
* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations
* Defend the proposed transition solutions and execution approaches to senior Client stakeholders / C\-suite audiences (Orals)
* Design AI\-powered transition solutions using GenAI\-based knowledge extraction, automated documentation generation, and intelligent codebase discovery to accelerate solutioning timelines
* Leverage AI estimating models and effort prediction tools to build data\-driven transition business cases and risk\-adjusted transition plans during pre\-sales
* Lead transitions of 100\+ applications spanning custom development, microservices, APIs, data platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and cloud\-native workloads

Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare)* BAU Handover
* Oversee structured code and architecture discovery activities — codebase walkthroughs, dependency mapping, tech\-debt assessment, and environment cataloging
* Ensure delivery of all transition artifacts: SOPs, Runbooks, Application Passports, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), RACI matrices, and operational documentation
* Manage Knowledge Acquisition sessions across development teams (onshore/offshore), ensuring structured capture of tribal knowledge, design rationale, and undocumented dependencies
* Deploy AI\-based code analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeScene, SonarQube AI) to accelerate codebase understanding, surface tech debt, and auto\-generate inline documentation during Knowledge Acquisition
* Use GenAI\-powered documentation tools to auto\-draft SOPs, Runbooks, and Application Passports from discovery sessions, reducing documentation effort by up to 40%
* Apply AI\-driven dependency mapping tools to visualize application interdependencies, integration touchpoints, and data flows across complex portfolios
* Establish and chair Transition Governance Forums — weekly/bi\-weekly SteerCos, RAID reviews, milestone checkpoint meetings, and executive reporting cadences
* Maintain a real\-time Transition Dashboard tracking milestones, knowledge transfer completion, risk status, team readiness scores, and go\-live criteria
* Drive RAID log management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and proactively resolve blockers impacting transition timelines
* Manage 50\+ active stakeholders — client executives, product owners, architects, vendor leads, and delivery managers — across multiple geographies
* Use AI\-powered project analytics tools and NLP\-based status reporting to auto\-generate executive dashboards and transition health summaries
* Define and execute Go\-Live Readiness Criteria encompassing access provisioning, monitoring setup, SLA framework validation, on\-call rota, and escalation paths
* Lead structured Hypercare operations post\-go\-live: stabilization sprints, defect triage, performance baselining, and SLA attainment tracking
* Ensure tooling readiness: ITSM (ServiceNow), observability stack (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog), CMDB accuracy, and alerting configuration
* Integrate AIOps capabilities (anomaly detection, predictive alerting) during Hypercare to proactively surface risks before they escalate to incidents
* Use ML\-based SLA prediction models to benchmark incoming team performance trajectories and forecast BAU stabilization timelines

**Requirements**

* 12–18 years of IT industry experience with significant tenure leading enterprise Application Transition programs
* Minimum 8 years of hands\-on experience transitioning Application Development portfolios within Managed Services or IT Outsourcing environments
* Proven track record managing transitions of 200\+ FTEs and 100\+ applications across multi\-geo delivery models
* Hands\-on exposure to AI tools and automation platforms used across the transition lifecycle (code analysis, documentation generation, test automation, AIOps)
* Experience managing transitions in Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models; able to adapt governance to match client maturity
* Demonstrated ability to manage 50\+ active stakeholders, including CXOs, Product Owners, Architects, and Vendor Leads

* Background in GenAI Tooling for Development, Prompt Engineering, and AI\-driven Code Analysis Tools

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
Job Summary
  
This Cyber Security Architect role focuses on designing implementing and optimizing secure network access solutions with strong emphasis on proxy operation secure remote access and cloud based security platforms. The architect will work in a hybrid model with rotational shifts ensuring resilient protection of enterprise users data and applications across global environments advancing the organization security posture and contributing to safer digital experiences for society.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design comprehensive secure access architectures that integrate proxy operation Zscaler Private Access Palo Alto Prisma Cisco Umbrella reverse proxy tools and Cisco VPN to protect enterprise users and data across hybrid environments
  
Implement robust security policies and configuration standards for web proxy platforms and reverse proxy tools that ensure consistent control of internet traffic and safeguard critical applications
  
Configure and optimize Zscaler Private Access deployments to deliver secure remote connectivity to internal applications while maintaining high performance and reliability for distributed teams
  
Deploy and maintain Palo Alto Prisma based security controls that provide advanced threat prevention and data protection across cloud services and remote endpoints
  
Administer Cisco Umbrella solutions to strengthen domain based filtering block malicious destinations and enhance protection against phishing and command and control activity
  
Manage Cisco VPN infrastructures to ensure secure scalable and resilient remote connectivity experiences for employees working in hybrid and rotational shift arrangements
  
Perform regular security posture assessments across proxy VPN and cloud security platforms to identify gaps recommend improvements and align configurations with organizational risk tolerance
  
Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to integrate security controls into existing architectures in a way that supports business operations and minimizes disruption for end users
  
Develop and maintain detailed architecture diagrams configuration baselines and technical documentation that support consistent operations and future scaling of cybersecurity solutions
  
Conduct incident analysis and problem resolution for security events related to proxy operation secure remote access and cloud edge security ensuring rapid containment and remediation
  
Drive continuous tuning of access policies authentication flows and content filtering rules to improve user experience while maintaining strong protection and regulatory compliance
  
Coordinate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure that security architectures meet internal standards and external obligations supporting trust from customers and partners
  
Support knowledge transfer and technical guidance for operational teams working in rotational shifts so that security platforms remain well managed and resilient at all times
  
  

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate strong experience in proxy operation and reverse proxy tools by configuring policies authentication methods and traffic inspection that align with modern enterprise security needs
  
Apply hands on expertise with Zscaler Private Access to design secure application access patterns optimize user connectivity and troubleshoot complex remote access scenarios
  
Utilize solid knowledge of Palo Alto Prisma to implement cloud delivered security services enrich threat protection and safeguard data across web and cloud application usage
  
Show practical proficiency with Cisco Umbrella by defining and managing DNS layer security strategies that reduce exposure to malicious destinations and enhance threat visibility
  
Exhibit deep understanding of Cisco VPN technologies to establish secure tunnels handle certificate and credential management and support hybrid work connectivity requirements
  
Combine at least five to eight years of cybersecurity architecture or engineering experience to evaluate solutions critically balance security and usability and advise stakeholders effectively
  
Employ strong analytical and problem solving abilities to investigate security issues interpret complex logs and recommend targeted improvements that strengthen the overall security posture
  
Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners to explain design decisions security risks and remediation plans in a concise and accessible manner
  
Adapt effectively to rotational shift patterns in a hybrid work environment by organizing responsibilities carefully and maintaining consistent operational focus on security controls
  
Maintain awareness of emerging threats modern secure access approaches and industry practices so that security architectures contribute positively to wider societal trust in digital services
  
Work collaboratively with cross functional technology teams to ensure that security solutions support business outcomes enable safe digital innovation and protect community interests
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Preferred certifications include CISSP CCSP or vendor credentials for Zscaler Palo Alto and Cisco security platforms

**Job Description:** BIM COORDINATOR

**Company:** TD Engineering and Consulting Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** West Mogappair, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech – Civil Engineering / B.Arch

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **BIM Coordinator** with 10\+ years of experience in the construction/engineering industry to lead and manage multidisciplinary BIM coordination activities. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP models**, identifying and resolving clashes, reviewing construction drawings and ensuring accurate and coordinated BIM deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be capable of **independently leading BIM coordination**, coordinating with internal departments, consultants, contractors and project/site teams, and driving projects from design coordination through construction and as\-built stages.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage **multidisciplinary BIM coordination** between Architectural, Civil, Structural, MEP, QS and Project teams.
* Review and coordinate BIM models and construction drawings to ensure **design accuracy, constructability and coordination**.
* Perform **clash detection, clash analysis and resolution** using Navisworks Manage and coordinate with respective discipline teams for timely closure.
* Manage and review BIM models up to **LOD 500**, including construction\-stage and as\-built requirements.
* Develop, implement and maintain **BIM Execution Plans, BIM standards, modelling procedures and QA/QC workflows**.
* Review model quality, naming conventions, model revisions, drawing outputs and BIM documentation.
* Coordinate with **Architects, Structural Engineers, MEP Engineers, QS, Project Managers, Contractors and Site Engineers** to resolve design and construction\-related coordination issues.
* Conduct and lead **BIM coordination meetings**, prepare clash/coordination reports and monitor closure of actions.
* Review shop drawings, coordinated drawings, model outputs and construction documentation for compliance with project requirements.
* Ensure proper model federation, version control, data management and coordination workflows.
* Support preparation and validation of **LOD 400/500 deliverables and as\-built BIM models**.
* Guide and mentor BIM Engineers/Modelers and ensure timely delivery of assigned BIM activities.
* Identify design conflicts at an early stage and proactively coordinate with relevant departments to minimize rework and site issues.
* Maintain effective communication between **design, engineering, BIM and construction teams** throughout the project lifecycle.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Autodesk Revit
* Navisworks
* AutoCAD
* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)

**Candidate Profile**

* **10\+ years of overall experience** in construction, engineering consultancy or BIM coordination.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **BIM coordination and multidisciplinary construction projects**.
* Proven experience in a **Lead BIM Coordinator / BIM Lead / Senior BIM Coordinator** role.
* Strong practical knowledge of **LOD 300, LOD 400 and LOD 500** workflows.
* Excellent understanding of **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP drawings** and construction methodology.
* Strong experience in **clash detection, coordination and issue resolution**.
* Should be capable of independently leading BIM activities and coordinating multiple teams.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in large\-scale residential, commercial, industrial or infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Knowledge of **ISO 19650 / BIM standards and information management** will be an added advantage.

Education

**B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering / B.Arch** 

What We Are Looking For

A **hands\-on BIM leader**, not just a modeller — someone who can understand drawings and construction requirements, lead multidisciplinary coordination, and ensure the project is delivered with **accurate, coordinated and construction\-ready BIM models**.

Interested Candidate can share their resume to **subha@tech\-develop.in**/Whatsapp \- **8122359328**

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

 Your New Role: The Senior Principal, System Architecture reports to the VP Engineering, Converged AdTech \& Linear Systems and leads the architecture for WBD’s most critical advertising technology platforms. This role owns and drives the systems automation architecture of core adtech platforms to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across the ecosystem. This role is accountable for the architecture, scalability, and operational excellence of systems spanning converged planning, linear and digital advertising, scheduling, and affiliate distribution. By architecting the platform rationalization, cloud migration, and next\-generation AI/ML\-enabled capabilities, the Principal ensures WBD’s ad\-tech stack is positioned to maximize monetization, enable automation, and deliver premium advertising experiences across all platforms.

 AI‑Driven \& Agentic Systems Automation
 



 Define and drive the long\-term architecture for AI\-powered and agentic systems across large\-scale AdTech platforms. • Architect autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop systems for deployment orchestration, infrastructure lifecycle, and incident response • Establish guardrails for safe, observable, and governed AI adoption (reliability, explainability, failure handling) • Integrate AI capabilities into core platform layers (decisioning, optimization, experimentation, operations) • Drive standardization of agentic workflows across engineering and operations Expectation: redefines how systems are built and operated using AI and not just adds features.
 







 Platform Architecture \& System Engineering
 



 Own the design and evolution of foundational platforms with strong system engineering principles. • Define architecture for core platforms (AdOps automation, optimization, identity, data, measurement, activation) with clear boundaries and contracts • Apply system engineering rigor across reliability, scalability, fault isolation, and performance under extreme load • Establish patterns for multi\-region, high\-availability, and disaster\-resilient systems • Drive platform standardization to reduce fragmentation and improve developer velocity Expectation: builds platforms that are resilient, composable, and operable at scale.
 







 Enterprise System Evolution \& Convergence Lead transformation of fragmented systems into a cohesive, converged AdTech ecosystem (linear \+ digital).
 



 • Identify systemic bottlenecks across latency, data consistency, and cross platform dependencies
 



 • Drive simplification of system topology and elimination of redundant architectures
 



 • Lead large\-scale modernization (monolith → services, siloed systems → shared platforms)
 



 • Ensure seamless interoperability across legacy and next\-gen systems Expectation: reduces long\-term complexity while enabling scale and agility.  • Evaluate emerging technologies (streaming, distributed systems, AI infra, Agentic AI, privacy tech) for strategic adoption • Mentor Principal engineers and architects on system design and trade offs • Establish architectural governance and decision frameworks Expectation: builds both systems and the people who design them.
 



 Technical Authority \& Execution Influence
 



 Act as the highest\-level technical authority across critical initiatives. • Review and approve architecture for high\-impact, high\-risk systems • Influence execution across orgs without direct authority • Intervene in complex programs to de\-risk delivery and ensure architectural integrity • Align engineering, product, and business stakeholders on critical trade offs Expectation: drives decisions that materially impact system and business outcomes
 



 Qualifications \& Experience
 



 • Systems Architecture Leadership: 15\+ years of experience architecting and scaling enterprise\-grade data platforms, with a proven track record in large scale ingestion, transformation, and activation pipelines.
 



 • Automation Expertise: Experience automating high‑availability, high‑throughput production environments, leveraging AI and agentic architectures.
 



 • Distributed Data Expertise: Advanced knowledge of open data Lakehouse formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), distributed compute frameworks (Spark, Flink, Presto), and streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).

 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 




  


**Your New Role**
**:** 




 The Senior Principal, System Architecture reports to the VP Engineering, Converged AdTech \& Linear Systems and leads the architecture for WBD’s most critical advertising technology platforms. This role owns and drives the systems automation architecture of core adtech platforms to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across the ecosystem. This role is accountable for the architecture, scalability, and operational excellence of systems spanning converged planning, linear and digital advertising, scheduling, and affiliate distribution. By architecting the platform rationalization, cloud migration, and next\-generation AI/ML\-enabled capabilities, the Principal ensures WBD’s ad\-tech stack is positioned to maximize monetization, enable automation, and deliver premium advertising experiences across all platforms.
 



  


**Your Role Accountabilities:**

**AI** 
**‑** 
**Driven \& Agentic Systems Automation** 




 Define and drive the long\-term architecture for AI\-powered and agentic systems across large\-scale AdTech platforms.
 


* Architect autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop systems for deployment orchestration, infrastructure lifecycle, and incident response
* Establish guardrails for safe, observable, and governed AI adoption (reliability, explainability, failure handling)
* Integrate AI capabilities into core platform layers (decisioning, optimization, experimentation, operations)
* Drive standardization of agentic workflows across engineering and operations



 Expectation: redefines how systems are built
 *and operated* 
 using AI and not just adds features.
 



  


**Platform Architecture \& System Engineering** 




 Own the design and evolution of foundational platforms with strong system engineering principles.
 


* Define architecture for core platforms (AdOps automation, optimization, identity, data, measurement, activation) with clear boundaries and contracts
* Apply system engineering rigor across reliability, scalability, fault isolation, and performance under extreme load
* Establish patterns for multi\-region, high\-availability, and disaster\-resilient systems
* Drive platform standardization to reduce fragmentation and improve developer velocity



 Expectation: builds platforms that are
 **resilient, composable, and operable at scale** 
 .
 



  


**Enterprise System Evolution \& Convergence**
 Lead transformation of fragmented systems into a cohesive, converged AdTech ecosystem (linear \+ digital).
 


* Identify systemic bottlenecks across latency, data consistency, and cross\-platform dependencies
* Drive simplification of system topology and elimination of redundant architectures
* Lead large\-scale modernization (monolith → services, siloed systems → shared platforms)
* Ensure seamless interoperability across legacy and next\-gen systems



  Expectation: reduces long\-term complexity while enabling scale and agility.
 



  


**Technology Strategy \& Architectural Leadership** 




 Shape the long\-term technology direction and elevate architectural capability across the organization.
 


* Evaluate emerging technologies (streaming, distributed systems, AI infra, Agentic AI, privacy tech) for strategic adoption
* Mentor Principal engineers and architects on system design and trade\-offs
* Establish architectural governance and decision frameworks



 Expectation: builds both
 **systems and the people who design them** 
 .
 



  


**Technical Authority \& Execution Influence**
 Act as the highest\-level technical authority across critical initiatives.
 


* Review and approve architecture for high\-impact, high\-risk systems
* Influence execution across orgs without direct authority
* Intervene in complex programs to de\-risk delivery and ensure architectural integrity
* Align engineering, product, and business stakeholders on critical trade\-offs



 Expectation: drives decisions that materially impact system and business outcomes
 






**Qualifications \& Experience** 
* **Systems Architecture Leadership** 
 : 15\+ years of experience architecting and scaling enterprise\-grade data platforms, with a proven track record in large\-scale ingestion, transformation, and activation pipelines.
* **Automation Expertise:** 
 Experience automating high‑availability, high‑throughput production environments, leveraging AI and agentic architectures.
* **Distributed Data Expertise** 
 : Advanced knowledge of open data Lakehouse formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), distributed compute frameworks (Spark, Flink, Presto), and streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).
* **Cloud \& Modern Architecture** 
 : Hands\-on expertise in cloud\-native data design (AWS, GCP, Azure), microservices, APIs, and serverless architectures; demonstrated success in modernizing legacy platforms into modular, cost\-efficient systems.
* **Identity \& Audience Platforms** 
 : Familiarity with identity resolution, audience graphs, and cross\-platform measurement systems in media, advertising, or adjacent high\-scale transaction domains.
* **Engineering Excellence** 
 : Deep knowledge of data engineering best practices, CI/CD automation, observability, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure reliability and compliance.
* **Performance \& Optimization** 
 : Skilled in cost modeling, benchmarking, and optimizing large\-scale distributed systems for throughput, latency, and cost efficiency.
* **Industry Awareness** 
 : Strong grasp of emerging trends in ad\-tech, programmatic ecosystems, ML/AI\-driven data products, and privacy\-first architectures (GDPR, CCPA, VPPA).
* **Partnerships \& Ecosystem** 
 : Experienced in leading technical evaluations, vendor integrations, and collaborations with third\-party data providers, cloud platforms, and open\-source communities.
* **Education** 
 : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline required























  


**How We Get Things Done…**

 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-SFL-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**AI Strategic Architect**
 SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business practice brings together several key capabilities to architect integrated programs that transform our clients' businesses, including Strategic Growth Transformation, Transformation Strategy \& Design, Technology Strategy \& Business Transformation, and AI \& Data Strategy.
   

  

 Professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the latest state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design and implement novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 We are hiring AI Strategic Architects to support and lead development, deployment, and maintenance of novel AI solutions and cloud architectures across healthcare, manufacturing, energy, retail, finance, and other sectors.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As an AI Strategic Architect at SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, you’ll work with a cross\-functional strategy and AI team to bring solutions to life.
   

  

 We seek individuals with a strategic mindset for planning and implementing AI systems for large\-scale organizations on both on\-prem and cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 You will be responsible for designing, deploying, benchmarking, and scaling solutions from test environments to global production, impacting millions. Key tasks also include gathering and understanding business requirements, identification of performance gaps, and the design and implementation of scalable solutions in the client’s environment.
   

  

 Successful candidates will work with non\-technical stakeholders, IT teams, and existing solution teams to translate requirements into a technical design, handling both strategic design and implementation tasks, to drive value for our clients.
   

  

**Design \& Planning** 
 :
   

  

* Work directly with clients, stakeholders and user groups to understand requirements and communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs.
* Interact with client IT teams to ensure solutions are compatible with their requirements and that deployment schedules are timely, efficient and well\-coordinated between teams.
* Integrate with a broader delivery team to design technical specifications that outline the resources, functions, interfaces and architecture of a scaled solution applicable to the common hyperscalers (AWS, GSP, Azure).
* Assess small scale functional AI solutions and determine performance gaps, required enhancements and technical solutions for deploying those solutions at scale \- this spans data security, latency considerations, large concurrent workloads, performance expectations, user requirements.
* Assist in documentation required for successful product deployment, this could include sustain processes, user guides, interface schematics etc.


**Execution** 
 :
   

  

* Sprint planning and implementation of technical architectures, this would include implementing CICD pipelines, deploying cloud resources, implementing Kubernetes based deployments, networking across cloud resources, ETL pipelines.
* Design and development of web\-based UI’s.
* Implementation and testing of core application enhancements with a focus on AI workloads (ex. RAG applications, multi\-agent workloads, AI modeling enhancements).


**The Team**
 SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, is a data science professional services practice focused on strategy, technology, and solving business challenges with Artificial Intelligence (AI). The team has a proven track record serving large, market\-leading organizations in the private and public sectors, successfully delivering high\-quality, novel and complex projects, and offering deep domain and scientific capabilities. Made up of experienced AI strategists, data scientists, and AI engineers, they serve as trusted advisors to executives, helping them understand and evaluate new and essential areas for AI investment and identify unique opportunities to transform their businesses.
   

  

**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant STEM Field (ex. Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics)
* 5\+ years of experience working in data science, data engineering, software engineering, and/or MLOps.
* Experience with cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, GCP), such as designing, building, and scaling using cloud tools such as AWS SageMaker or Azure ML Studio.
* 5\+ years working with core cloud application development tools \& services (ex. Kubernetes, docker, Argo CD, Jenkins, Terraform, DVC, MLFlow, Kubeflow, FastAPI, ADO).
* 3\+ years’ experience with implementing application with genAI toolsets (ex. Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, OpenLLM, vLLM, NIM, NEMO, LangFuse)


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign** 
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Graduate level degree (Masters/PhD) or Undergraduate level degree (B.Tech) in relevant STEM field (Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering etc.) from premier colleges such as IIT, BITS, NIT, and IISC
* 3\+ years of experience in AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis in the major data modalities from NLP, time\-series analysis, computer vision, to graph models with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models.
* 3\+ years of experience in core programming languages and data science packages (Python, Keras, Tensorflow, PyTorch, Pandas, Scikit\-learn, etc.)
* Experience in designing robust software engineering solutions.
* Demonstrated excellence in verbal and written communication skills and experience in a client\-facing or team management role.
* Highly proficient written and verbal skills to support briefings, proposals, technical sprint plans, solution reports, progress updates, and executive presentations.
* 2\+ years’ experience designing and developing web\-based UI’s using React.
* 2\+ years’ experience with data tools and databases (ex. MongoDB, RDS) and vector databases (ex. Milvus, ChromaDB, ElasticSearch, Pinecone).
* 2\+ years’ experience with scripting languages with a heavy emphasis on python.
* Familiarity with Linux operating systems and bash scripting.
* Familiarity with monitoring, alert tools and dashboards (ex. Grafana, Prometheus, Tableau, PowerBI)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

description:

**Job Title:** 
 R\&D Member of Technical Staff II, Cloud Operations \& Infrastructure
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad/Bangalore
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Work Mode** 
 : Hybrid work arrangement
   

  

***At AVEVA, we’re all about limitless possibilities. Are you?***
 As part of the Research and Development function, the global Cloud Operations \& Infrastructure team combines software development and cloud operations to provide continuous integration and delivery of cloud\-enabled products and solutions, along with continuous monitoring to ensure various cloud\-specific customer requirements/SLAs are met.
   

  

 As a Cloud Operations Engineer you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced cloud\-based applications and services. Your work will focus on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud computing, exploring new technologies, and developing innovative solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals.
   

  

 Working closely with your development and portfolio colleagues, together you will bring new solutions to the cloud following a standard framework to ensure they are operationally secure, stable and scalable.
   

  

 The global, 24x7 nature of the team means there may be a requirement for occasional work outside of the standard day and to be on call as part of a shared team rota.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work on modern approaches to software development including the ability to develop microservices and leverage serverless functions.
* Work with development teams to advise and contribute to improvements to operational stability, security, cost management and reporting requirements for our cloud solutions.
* Continually develop and improve DevOps processes, adding value through optimization, automation, and effective reporting.
* Provide timely and effective response to incidents to minimize the impact on our customers and keep colleagues updated as required.
* Oversee relevant Cloud deployments to ensure successful implementation, track and report progress, resolve or escalate release issues.
* Proactively manage cloud environments to minimize service impacting issues, including infrastructure as code, certificates, storage, health status, backup status etc.
* Ensure new services meet required operational readiness standards before being accepted into operations.
* Ensure on\-going compliance to security practices and policies.
* Provide subject matter expertise to business stakeholders as required.
* Maintain clear and accurate operational documentation.
* Stay current on security industry trends, tools and best practices.


**Essential Requirements**
 The following list applies to Azure and/or AWS Platforms.
   

  

* At least 4 years of experience in software development or DevOps/SRE, with at least 3 years of focus on Cloud environments.
* Strong programming skills, e.g. C\#, .NET Core or Java.
* Knowledge of PowerShell or Node JS or Python scripting.
* Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API, REST, microservices, serverless architecture.
* Knowledge of Cloud Authentication protocols such as OAuth, Identity Servers, OpenID Connect and SAML etc…
* Knowledge of Azure administration, Azure APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, APIO Management, Service Bus, Event Grids, Storage Accounts and Key Vaults and tools. Or, equivalent AWS experience.
* Knowledge and experience of operational support, software development and deployment methodologies and principles.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to convey information clearly and concisely to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Attention to detail, diligent and tenacious.
* Excellent analysis and dissemination skills.
* High degree of personal motivation and ability to self\-manage.
* Maintains and develops relevant industry and technology knowledge.


**Desired Skills And Competencies**
* Certifications in Azure and/or AWS.
* Hands\-on experience working within an Information Security accredited framework e.g. ISO27001, 27017/18\.
* Experience working in Agile software development such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


**R\&D at AVEVA**
 Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
   

  

 Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r\-and\-d\-careers/
   

  

**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 By default, employees are expected to be in their local AVEVA office three days a week, but some positions are fully office\-based. Roles supporting particular customers or markets are sometimes remote.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process
   

  

**About AVEVA**
 AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
   

  

 AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
   

  

 AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. **But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. You’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy is your next move.**
**The Team**
 The AI and Hybrid Infrastructure team sits at the core of Deloitte’s technology\-enabled transformation agenda. We advise clients on where and how to modernize their infrastructure landscape — spanning data centers, hybrid and multi\-cloud platforms, networks, and AI\-enabled infrastructure — to support business growth, resilience, and innovation.

* AI Infrastructure strategy
* AI Economics / Tokenomics strategy
* Hybrid Cloud strategy
* Enterprise Infrastructure and platform enablement
* Legacy modernization and technical debt reduction
* Cost optimization, resilience, and scalability
* Technology operating model and governance design
* AI / Hybrid Cloud sourcing strategies

We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who combine strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of modern infrastructure and AI ecosystems.

 As part of the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy team, you will work with clients to shape and execute their AI infrastructure and platform strategies across hybrid environments (Cloud. On\-premise, Edge) ensuring alignment with broader business and digital transformation goals.

title: Lead HashiVault Engineer [T500-29209]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**Who are we:** 




 Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.
 



 CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.
 



 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product \& process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Secrets Management Engineer to own, evolve, and secure our enterprise secrets management platform. You will be the subject matter expert for tools such as HashiCorp Vault (or equivalent), driving adoption, best practices, and engineering standards across the organisation.
 



 This is a high\-impact, hands\-on technical role at the intersection of cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and infrastructure engineering. You will work closely with platform, cloud, and application engineering teams to ensure secrets — credentials, certificates, API keys, encryption keys — are managed securely, at scale, and in line with zero\-trust principles.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Platform Ownership \& Engineering:** 



* Design, deploy, and operate a highly available, scalable secrets management platform (e.g. HashiCorp Vault Enterprise, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, CyberArk).
* Define and enforce secrets management architecture, policies, and standards across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments.
* Manage Vault clusters including HA configuration, replication, auto\-unseal (e.g. via AWS KMS or Azure Key Vault), and disaster recovery.
* Build and maintain Terraform/IaC modules, Helm charts, and automation pipelines for platform deployment and configuration.
* Own the full lifecycle of secrets: creation, rotation, revocation, leasing, and auditing.



  





**Security \& Compliance:** 



* Implement and maintain dynamic secrets, PKI certificate management, and database credential rotation.
* Develop and enforce RBAC, ACL policies, and names pacing within Vault to enforce least\-privilege access.
* Conduct regular access reviews, audit log analysis, and security assessments of the secrets platform.
* Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks and regulations including ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, and NIST guidelines.
* Drive zero\-trust architecture principles across secrets distribution and access patterns.



  





**DevSecOps \& Integration:** 



* Integrate secrets management tooling with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) to eliminate hard\-coded credentials.
* Build Vault Agent, sidecar injection, and Kubernetes Secrets Store CSI Driver integrations for containerised workloads.
* Partner with application and DevOps teams to migrate away from legacy secrets handling patterns toward dynamic, short\-lived credentials.
* Develop SDKs, libraries, and internal tooling to simplify developer adoption of secrets management APIs.



  





**Leadership \& Enablement:** 



* Act as the internal SME and evangelist for secrets management — mentoring engineers and running enablement sessions.
* Define and own the secrets management roadmap, balancing security uplift with engineering velocity.
* Produce and maintain runbooks, architecture documentation, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security architecture, risk, and compliance teams on controls and evidence for audits.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 




**Essential:** 



* 5\+ years in a cybersecurity, infrastructure, or platform engineering role, with at least 3 years of hands\-on HashiCorp Vault (or equivalent) experience.
* Deep expertise in Vault architecture: cluster setup, auth methods (AppRole, Kubernetes, AWS IAM, LDAP, OIDC), secret engines, policies, and audit devices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills — Python, Bash, Go, or similar.
* Infrastructure as Code proficiency — Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container\-native secrets injection patterns (CSI driver, Vault Agent Injector).
* Solid understanding of PKI, TLS/mTLS, certificate lifecycle management, and encryption key management (HSM experience a plus).
* Familiarity with cloud\-native secrets services across AWS (Secrets Manager, KMS, Parameter Store), Azure (Key Vault), and/or GCP (Secret Manager).
* Strong understanding of zero\-trust architecture, least\-privilege access, and RBAC.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration and secrets hygiene in software delivery.



  





**Desirable:** 



* HashiCorp Vault Associate or Professional certification.
* Experience with CyberArk, Conjur, or other PAM/secrets platforms.
* Exposure to SIEM integration and secrets\-related threat detection (e.g. detecting credential misuse via audit logs).
* Experience in a regulated environment (financial services, healthcare, government).
* Familiarity with service mesh and mTLS patterns (Istio, Consul Connect).
* Open\-source contributions or public technical writing related to secrets management.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonus.
* Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
* Dedicated learning and certification budget (including HashiCorp, cloud, and security certifications).
* Exposure to a complex, large\-scale, multi\-cloud environment.
* Collaborative, psychologically safe team culture with a genuine security\-first mission.
* Private healthcare, pension, and additional benefits package.



*We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. This job description is indicative and may be subject to change in line with business needs.*

description:
