The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 MuleSoft’s Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that shape the future.
   

  

**As a Practice Manager, You Get To**
 Lead a team of technical architects and consultants as they deliver MuleSoft solutions to our customers. In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners to solve critically important business challenges using MuleSoft’s Anypoint Platform. You will lead customer, partner, and MuleSoft technical teams through multi\-phased delivery projects and provide hands\-on delivery guidance to influence standards for development, governance, and the operational life cycle.
   

  

 You will be a key member of the cross\-functional MuleSoft leadership team. Collaboration and alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Pre\-Sales, and Product teams will be integral to your success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of technical architects and consultants as they deliver MuleSoft solutions to our customers.
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce and MuleSoft environments, optimizing API performance, data orchestration, and platform resource consumption
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document complex integration solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases

* Excellent verbal and written technical documentation skills.
* Experience managing people and projects in a matrix'd environment.
* Ability to establish credibility with smart engineers quickly, motivate people, instill accountability, and achieve results.

title: Principal, Terraform Engineering
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Principal, Terraform Engineering
   

  

 Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly experienced engineering leader with
 **15\+ years of expertise** 
 in infrastructure automation and cloud engineering. As the Principal Terraform Engineering Lead, you will drive the
 **innovative adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** 
 across Azure, AWS, and on\-premise private cloud platforms. This role is pivotal in establishing
 **Terraform best practices, standardization, resiliency, and observability** 
 while leading the enterprise\-wide adoption of Terraform Enterprise within a large financial organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership: Define and lead the enterprise\-wide Terraform adoption strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Infrastructure as Code Excellence: Architect and implement standardized IaC frameworks across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments (Azure, AWS, private cloud).
* Terraform Enterprise Adoption: Drive rollout, governance, and operationalization of Terraform Enterprise at scale across global teams.
* DevOps Expertise: SME in driving DevOps CICD in IaC implementation.
* Resiliency \& Observability: Embed resiliency, monitoring, and observability into IaC practices to ensure robust and compliant infrastructure delivery.
* Standardization \& Governance: Establish enterprise\-wide standards, guardrails, and reusable modules to accelerate adoption and reduce risk.
* Hands\-on Engineering: Provide technical leadership and hands\-on expertise in Terraform, cloud automation, and infrastructure modernization.
* Collaboration \& Influence: Partner with product engineering, risk governance, and infrastructure teams to drive adoption and innovation.
* Continuous Improvement: Champion automation, efficiency, and secure delivery practices across the organization.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, automation, and cloud technologies.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in Terraform (Open Source \& Enterprise), with proven ability to design and scale IaC solutions.
* Strong architectural background in multi\-cloud (Azure, AWS) and private cloud platforms.
* Experience driving enterprise\-wide adoption of IaC frameworks in regulated industries.
* Proven ability to embed resiliency, observability, and compliance into infrastructure delivery pipelines.
* Strong leadership edge with experience as a global service owner or platform lead.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Background**
* Experience in financial services or global banking organizations.
* Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (ISO, NIST, DORA, PRA, CSA CCM).
* Expertise in cloud modernization, automation frameworks, and operational resilience.


**Leadership Attributes**
* Visionary leader with the ability to transform infrastructure delivery at scale.
* Collaborative and influential communicator across global teams and executive stakeholders.
* Recognized as a trusted advisor and problem solver in infrastructure modernization.
* Passionate about driving innovation, standardization, and resilience in technology delivery.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Container Orchestration \& Infrastructure**
* Manage containerized deployments via Docker and Kubernetes on Linux and Windows Server
* Provision and manage Kubernetes clusters (dev, staging, production) with horizontal pod autoscaling
* Configure service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) for inter\-service mTLS; manage container image registry lifecycle

 AWS, GCP, or Azure (multi\-cloud preferred)

 Advanced Bash \& Python scripting

 Container scanning: Trivy, Snyk, or Clair

* HashiCorp Vault

* SOC 2, EU CRA, FedRAMP pipeline controls


**Monitoring \& Observability:** 
 ELK/EFK, Loki, or Splunk

* GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux for continuous delivery
* SRE practices: error budget management, chaos engineering (LitmusChaos, Chaos Monkey)

* 5\+ years of CI/CD pipeline management (GitLab CI preferred)

**Job Description**
 On a day\-to\-day basis, this individual will be responsible for administrating and implementing database solutions while providing system operational support, administration, problem resolution, and perform software installations and upgrades on our database systems concentrating on Google Cloud Platform and other cloud\-based solutions (up to 30%). The Database Administrator will be expected to exhibit strong troubleshooting techniques while striving to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Other duties also include monitoring performance and capacity on our database systems.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
   

  

* Responsibility for all enterprise database technology deployed in the cloud including various versions of Microsoft SQL Server and other database platforms including features such as the core database engine, reporting, data loading and transformations, business intelligence, replication technologies and other modules. Perform configuration and maintenance of database platforms, including patching.
* Monitor database instances for performance, utilization, and capacity. Work with application teams when appropriate to address issues.
* Manage maintenance plans, backups, and automated jobs.
* Responsible for the database platform security model, including using Active Directory\-integrated accounts in a multi\-forest environment where appropriate.
* Responsible for query writing and optimization.
* Responsible for database schema design.
* Develop, administer, and optimize Google BigQuery datasets, tables, views, partitioning, clustering, permissions, scheduled queries, and data pipelines to support reporting, analytics, and operational workloads.
* Responsible for advising report writers and their deployment in various reporting solutions or writing reports when needed.
* Support BigQuery SQL development, performance tuning, cost optimization, data governance, access controls, and integration with Google Cloud services, business intelligence tools, and enterprise data platforms.
* Use typical database, cloud, monitoring, and DevOps tools such as Google Cloud Console, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Dataflow, Dataproc, Looker, Tableau, SQL Server Management Studio, Visual Studio Code, Git, CI/CD release tools, PowerShell, Python, and ticketing or incident management platforms.
* Apply experience with AI agents and automation tools to improve database operations, including monitoring, incident triage, knowledge retrieval, documentation generation, operational workflows, and data\-driven self\-service capabilities.
* Responsible for performing traces and profiling to analyze and troubleshoot problems.
* Determine the best way to improve performance, whether through hardware adjustments, server configuration changes, or index and query changes.
* Understanding of software development methodologies, software development lifecycle management, and working in an Agile/SCRUM environment with software development teams, providing consultative advice on database design and query optimization, including indexes.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools for managing releases.
* Familiarity with code repository tools for managing SQL objects as code with version control.
* On\-call support for after\-hours issues required. Leverage automated alerting to be notified of issues as they happen. Tune alerts to reduce noise.
* Responds to incoming phone, email, or web\-reported technical issues from internal users related to network and infrastructure, and assists in troubleshooting database issues as well as application issues for which the database may be a contributing factor.
* Identifies severity and impact and documents details in the Help Desk call tracking system.
* Performs database monitoring to ensure service level agreements are met and alerts appropriate IT staff and management of any downtime.
* Works in partnership with all IT teams to find solutions, and/or escalates issues to appropriate IT groups for resolution.
* Communicates status and updates to end users in a timely and consistent manner.
* Sets priorities for open issues and escalates issues to the correct department for resolution.
* Follows through with closure of user issues.
* Recreates problems in development environments for troubleshooting and resolution when needed.
* Creates and documents workarounds.
* Assist in training.


**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**
 The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in database administration in a cloud\-based enterprise environment, preferably across multiple versions of cloud providers using multiple database platforms.
* Administrative knowledge of Active Directory and other forms of database security
* Scripting and automation experience
* Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated strong customer service and analytic skills
* Demonstrated ability to think through sets of complex problems, create and implement appropriate solutions
* Proven ability to establish and maintain effective professional working relationships
* Ability to think and work independently
* Ability to adapt and learn in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Administrative experience with at least one of Azure, Google Cloud, AWS
* Experience using or supporting AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions for database administration, cloud operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, or analytics use cases.
* Linux experience a plus.
* Administration experience in backup technologies that can be used to back up various database platforms. Additional experience in Disaster Recovery technologies a plus.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10\+ Years of experience preferred spanning more than one environment
* MongoDB and other non\-Microsoft SQL Server database technologies a plus
* Data Warehousing experience a plus
* Hands\-on Google Cloud database administration experience, including BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, IAM, performance tuning, cost optimization, and data governance.
* Experience using or supporting AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions to improve database administration, cloud operations, monitoring, incident triage, documentation, analytics, and self\-service workflows.
* PowerShell scripting and automation experience a plus


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our Cultural Beliefs**
**Patient Minded** 
 I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
   

  

**Client Delight** 
 I own every client experience and its impact on results.

title: SR. Technical Support
description:
Position Overview
   

  

 The Senior Technical Support Executive will be responsible for delivering advanced technical support, handling complex IT infrastructure issues, and leading deployment/implementation activities across client environments. This role requires deep handson expertise in networking, servers, virtualization, cloud platforms, security, surveillance systems, and backup/DC–DR technologies.
   

  

 The candidate will also mentor junior engineers, lead critical projects, and ensure high service quality and client satisfaction.
   

  

  

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Advanced Technical Support \& Troubleshooting
   

  

 Handle escalated L2/L3 support tickets related to network, server, cloud, and security environments.
   

 Diagnose and resolve complex issues involving hardware, software, OS, network, and cloud services.
   

 Perform onsite support for highpriority cases and customer escalations.
   

 Coordinate with OEM support teams for advanced issues.
   

  

  

  

 2\. Network Infrastructure Management
   

  

 Configure and troubleshoot Layer 2 \& Layer 3 networks, including:
   

  

 Switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers
   

 VLANs, routing protocols, VPNs, QoS, and network security policies
   

 Implement wireless solutions, WiFi controllers, heat mapping, and RF optimization.
   

 Monitor and optimize network performance using specialized tools.
   

  

  

  

 3\. Server, Virtualization \& Storage
   

  

 Deploy, configure, and manage:
   

  

 Windows Server (AD, GPO, DFS, DHCP, DNS)
   

 HyperV / VMware ESXi virtual environments
   

 File servers, application servers, domain controllers
   

 Perform server hardening, patching, and performance tuning.
   

 Work with NAS/SAN storage and iSCSI environments.
   

  

  

  

 4\. Cybersecurity \& Surveillance Systems
   

  

 Configure and maintain firewall policies, UTM features, IPS/IDS, web filtering, and endpoint security.
   

 Deploy and troubleshoot CCTV/IP surveillance systems, NVR/VMS configurations.
   

 Implement security best practices and perform periodic audits.
   

  

  

  

 5\. Data Backup, Replication, DC–DR
   

  

 Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot backup solutions (Veeam, Acronis, Synology, Cloud Backup, etc.).
   

 Configure backup jobs, replication, and retention policies.
   

 Execute DC–DR drills, failover, failback, and business continuity tasks.
   

 Maintain backup health checks and ensure recovery readiness.
   

  

  

  

 6\. Cloud Solutions (Microsoft 365 \& Azure)
   

  

 Manage M365 environment (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, security \& compliance).
   

 Deploy and support Azure services:
   

  

 Virtual Machines
   

 Backup \& Site Recovery
   

 Networking and identity (Azure AD)
   

 Handle migrations (email, servers, data).
   

  

  

  

 7\. Team Leadership \& Coordination
   

  

 Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and midlevel engineers.
   

 Review service tickets, ensure SLA adherence, and improve support quality.
   

 Lead projects, deployments, and client IT transformations.
   

 Coordinate with sales, project, and management teams for solution delivery.
   

  

  

  

 8\. Documentation \& Reporting
   

  

 Prepare detailed documentation for configurations, network diagrams, and change logs.
   

 Maintain SOPs and best practice guides.
   

 Provide reports on incident trends, problem resolutions, and improvement areas.
   

  

  

  

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

 3–7 years of experience in IT support or system integration.
   

 Strong knowledge of:
   

  

 Switching, routing, firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet, Sophos, Mikrotik, etc.)
   

 Windows Server \& Active Directory
   

 HyperV / VMware virtualization
   

 Backup solutions (Veeam, Acronis, Synology)
   

 M365 \& Azure administration
   

 NAS/SAN storage \& surveillance systems
   

 Strong handson troubleshooting and rootcause analysis skills.
   

  

  

  

 Soft Skills
   

  

 Excellent communication \& clienthandling skills.
   

 Leadership qualities, mentoring ability, and ownership mindset.
   

 Ability to manage multiple projects \& escalations simultaneously.
   

 Strong documentation and presentation skills.
   

  

  

  

 Preferred Certifications
   

  

 CCNA / CCNP
   

 Fortinet NSE4 or above
   

 Az900 / MS900 / Azure Admin Associate
   

 VMware VCP or Microsoft Virtualization
   

 Veeam VMCE
   

 CompTIA Security\+

title: Senior Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect (AWS to GCP Migration)
description:
SourceFuse Technologies hiring Senior Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect (AWS to GCP Migration) with 6\+ years of experience.
 



  





**Preferred Location\- Noida/Mohali** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**Migration Strategy and Delivery Leadership** 



* Own the end to end technical strategy for the AWS to GCP migration, including target architecture, migration sequencing, and cutover approach.
* Produce and maintain the Technical Design Document (TDD), including low level component diagrams, at a level of detail a client engineering team can implement against.
* Establish and maintain a Key Design Decision (KDD) log capturing the rationale for major architecture choices, for example service equivalency decisions such as Cloud Run versus other compute options.
* Build and maintain a Migration and Rollback Plan, and an accurate, current Component Inventory of everything in scope for migration.
* Run weekly governance and status reporting, and maintain a Deliverables and Acceptances Log so the client always has a clear, current record of what has been delivered and approved.



  





**Migration Execution** 



* Diagnose and resolve codebase divergence between environments, including establishing a snapshot and reconciliation approach where none currently exists.
* Lead migration of core services, including compute, container workloads, and identity/authentication, from the source cloud to GCP equivalents.
* Own data migration validation where the target uses a different database engine than the source (for example, a document or key\-value store migration such as DynamoDB to Firestore), including building or reviewing validation scripts and consistency reports.
* Define and implement a cross\-cloud connectivity approach (private networking between environments) for the duration of the migration.
* Define the scope and implementation of any cross\-cloud abstraction layer required to keep the platform portable during and after migration.
* Plan and execute large scale data and feed migrations (dozens of independent feeds or integrations), with a clear enablement and validation package for each.
* Migrate logging and observability tooling, for example a self\-managed ELK stack, to GCP native or GCP\-compatible equivalents, with log routing fully validated before cutover.



  





**Infrastructure and Compatibility** 



* Build and maintain the target GCP landing zone and core infrastructure using IaC, Terraform preferred, so environments are repeatable, reviewable, and version controlled.
* Own the CI/CD pipeline build for the new environment.
* Drive remediation of the service compatibility assessment, translating flagged incompatible services into a prioritized, sequenced backlog ahead of cutover.
* Review pull requests from client engineers where the client team is doing migration work in parallel, and keep that work aligned to the agreed target design.



  





**Cutover and Post\-Migration** 



* Plan and lead the production cutover, including go and no go criteria, rollback triggers, and a data consistency and parity validation approach.
* Produce platform documentation and operational runbooks, and lead technical handover and enablement sessions for the client's internal team.
* Provide a defined period of post\-cutover expert advisory support, including an operational protocol and escalation matrix.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* Proven experience leading at least one large scale, production cloud migration end to end, from planning through cutover, ideally cross\-cloud.
* Deep, hands on GCP experience across compute (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, App Engine), data and storage (Firestore, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Bigtable, Memorystore), and networking (VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS).
* Working familiarity with AWS is useful for reading and reasoning about the source environment, for example Cognito, DynamoDB, and Lambda, though deep AWS expertise is not required for this role.
* Advanced Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, and automated deployment workflows.
* Experience migrating between different database engines, including designing or validating data consistency and correctness checks.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems, using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Audit Logs for root cause analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear technical design documentation, and to run structured governance and status reporting for a client or stakeholder audience.
* Comfortable owning ambiguous, partially defined scope and turning it into a documented, sequenced plan under time pressure.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience migrating identity and authentication between cloud providers, for example Cognito to an equivalent GCP or third party identity service.
* Experience migrating self\-managed Elasticsearch or ELK deployments to managed or cloud native alternatives.
* Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, such as IAM, least privilege, Secret Manager, and VPC Service Controls, sufficient to keep the migrated environment secure by design. This is not primarily a security hardening role.
* Experience standing up a post go\-live managed services capability: ongoing monitoring, operational efficiency improvements, and automated operational actions.
* Experience with data sovereignty sensitive or regulated workloads, and with multi\-region deployments.

title: Software Development Manager, AWS DynamoDB
description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission\-critical workloads operating at more than 100 million requests per second? Let's take its speed and efficiency to the next level!



Amazon DynamoDB is a key\-value and document database that delivers single\-digit\-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast\-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission\-critical workloads.



We are looking for an engineering leader eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB.



As a software development manager on the DynamoDB team, you will lead a team of passionate engineers to build reliable and highly scalable distributed systems. This is a good opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of cloud database services, grow as a technology leader, and work with some really smart people. To succeed in the role, you must be passionate about both solving deep technical challenges and being a great people manager. You must care deeply about system availability and reliability, and understand what it means to own a mission\-critical service that handles hundreds of millions of requests per second, with sub\-millisecond latencies and eight 9s of availability. You must be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. The right candidate will be smart, ambitious, love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun. Building, motivating and mentoring a world\-class systems \& software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day\-to\-day people and performance management tasks.



You must have a strong Agile product management and delivery experience. The successful candidate will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Agile methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value\-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross\-team projects. You will set the vision of how to evolve DynamoDB going forward.



You must have a strong operational experience, with a track record of operating highly available fault tolerant systems. The right candidate will want to measure everything and be very data driven. They will excel at using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of their team. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment.



If you want to test your limits, build a world\-class team, and tackle challenges at a scale and level of impact rarely seen, join us!



About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
